title: V-FAT: Benchmarking Visual Fidelity Against Text-bias

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on atypical or counterfactual images using neutral queries to test whether learned statistical language priors from pretraining data override actual visual evidence.

Pairing standard images with explicitly misleading text prompts to measure alignment-induced sycophancy, observing whether the model contradicts valid visual evidence to comply with the user's false assertion.
